subject: Stellus Bank: encryption evidence pack and rotation runbook request
messages:
From: Andrea Lopez <alopez@stellusbank.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: compliance@stellusbank.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Stellus: encryption evidence request (SIG / CAIQ sections on KMS/HSM)

Hi Ben,

Thanks for continuing to work with our onboarding team. As part of Stellus Bank's SIG/CAIQ review we need a compact evidence bundle focused on encryption and key management. Specifically we're looking for: 

- HSM attestation (vendor cert + operator access matrix)
- Sample key rotation logs (last 90 days) with timestamps and operator IDs
- A short runbook describing how you perform KEK wrapping and envelope encryption for tenant BYOK scenarios
- Confirmation of at-rest and in-transit protections (SSE-S3 / TLS ciphers / key wrapping)

We understand some items will be redacted — that's fine. Can you confirm what you can deliver within 3 business days and what will need an additional week? Also please indicate whether the HSM evidence is from a managed service (CloudHSM) or a customer on-prem HSM, and whether the attestation is FIPS/FI-certified.

Appreciate a point of contact for any technical follow-ups.

Thanks,
Andrea Lopez
Senior InfoSec Manager — Stellus Bank

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Andrea Lopez <alopez@stellusbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stellus: encryption evidence request (SIG / CAIQ sections on KMS/HSM)

Andrea —

Thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide a concise evidence pack. High level answers up front: 

- HSM attestation: Redwood uses a mix of AWS CloudHSM for hosted tenants and FIPS 140-2 Level 2/3-certified appliances (vendor: Thales) for Dedicated/private installs. We can provide the most recent attestation PDF for the environment you are onboarding to (CloudHSM usage vs private HSM).
- Rotation logs: we can deliver a redacted CSV with rotation events, key IDs (hashed), operator principal (redacted to role), and RFC3339 timestamps for the last 90 days. Attached is a sample CSV layout.
- Runbook: we'll provide a 2-page runbook that outlines KEK/DEK separation, wrapping process, envelope encryption flow, and automated rotation cadence.
- At-rest/in-transit: short statement plus network diagram showing TLS termination points, cipher suites, and SSE-KMS configuration for object storage.

Timeline: initial bundle (attestation PDF + rotation sample CSV + runbook draft + checksums) in 3 business days. Supplemental items (full operator access matrix export, signed FIPS certificates, and audit-log extracts) within 7–10 business days.

I'll loop Jonas for the technical artifacts and Marissa for the packaging and delivery. We'll upload to a secure share and provide hashed manifests.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): kms-rotation-log-sample.csv (stub)

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Andrea Lopez <alopez@stellusbank.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stellus: encryption evidence request (SIG / CAIQ sections on KMS/HSM)

Andrea / Ben —

A few technical clarifications so we include exactly what you need: 

1) Which tenant model are you assessing? Our hosted offering (multi-tenant with envelope encryption + tenant key separation) vs Dedicated tenant (customer-managed HSM via BYOK) changes the set of artifacts. If this is a production tenant on our Hosted plan, we'll provide CloudHSM attestations and KMS service-account role exports. For Dedicated/Private we can provide appliance attestation and on-prem operator roster exports.

2) For rotation logs: do you need full key material hashes, or is a key-id + rotation-event + operator-role acceptable? We prefer to redact operator PII and provide role-level mappings (e.g., "KMS Operator - rotation"), plus the access matrix CSV that maps role -> allowed actions.

3) For SIG/CAIQ mapping: would it help if we produce a 1-page mapping that ties each artifact to the CAIQ question IDs (e.g., encr: key rotation, encr: key custody, tls: in-transit)? We can do that and include it in the manifest.

What we'll prepare in the 3-day bundle: 
- hsm-attestation-2026-06.pdf (attestation cert; redactions possible)
- kms-rotation-log-sample.csv (rotations, hashed key ids, timestamps, role-level operator)
- redacted-access-matrix.csv (role -> capabilities)
- envelope-encryption-runbook.pdf (2 pages)
- evidence-manifest-checksums.txt (SHA256 checksums + mapping to CAIQ/SIG items)

Security notes: rotation automation is performed by a privileged service account that mints short-lived signing tokens; audit events are forwarded to our immutable event store with retention aligned to SOC 2/ISO policies. We'll redact anything that would compromise private keys.

If that's acceptable, we'll stage the bundle to the drive link Ben mentioned and create a single DocuSign acknowledgement for Stellus to sign (standard evidence access T&Cs).

— Jonas Weber
Security Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Andrea Lopez <alopez@stellusbank.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: compliance@stellusbank.com, Kyle Park <kyle.park@stellusbank.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stellus: encryption evidence request (SIG / CAIQ sections on KMS/HSM)

Ben / Jonas —

Thank you, that plan sounds good. To answer your questions: we are assessing a Hosted tenant with the intention to expand to Dedicated for higher-tier workloads later; role-level redactions are fine. Yes, please include the CAIQ/SIG mapping page — that will speed internal review.

We can accept the 3-day bundle for initial review. Please upload to the shared drive and paste the link here when ready. We'll review and send back any follow-ups by Friday. Also please include the expected date for the 7–10 day supplemental items in the manifest.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Andrea Lopez
Senior InfoSec Manager — Stellus Bank
